scientific_question: Can a bounded normal-only actuator convert identified correctability into safe deployable threshold adaptation?

frozen_background.pb7p0_best_always_on: T2 mean delta_BA +0.040, CI_lo +0.021, mean delta_FNR +0.056 (FULL)

utility_definition.ranking: AUROC/AUPR consistency check only (threshold-only must not change ranking)

dev_usage: choose a single global operating setting
dev_test_firewall.test_usage: one frozen evaluation; no test outcome feedback

actuator_families.A_T2_RAW: tau_raw = median_t + (MAD_t/MAD_s)*(tau_source - median_s); exact PB7-P0 T2 formula (MAD_s ~= 0 guarded)
actuator_families.A_TAIL_RAW: tau_raw = Q95(target-normal); exact PB7-P0 T3 formula
actuator_families.A_MEDIAN_RAW: tau_raw = tau_source + (median_t - median_s); conservative location-only, PB7-P0 median_shift rationale

bounding.note: bounding only shrinks toward tau_source or abstains; never flips direction, no anomaly-dependent sign switch

abstention_gate.signal: median_shift (PB7-P0 PASS-B principal, AUC 0.712 / LCO 0.714 / K8 0.802)
abstention_gate.form: adapt iff median_shift >= c else NoAdapt

H1_BOUNDED_CORRECTION_RETAINS_UTILITY.claim: limiting actuator correction magnitude retains substantial positive delta_BA

H2_SAFETY_IMPROVES_MONOTONICALLY_WITH_CO.claim: as lambda decreases, delta_FNR and harm rate decrease monotonically

H3_ABSTENTION_ADDS_SAFETY_VALUE.claim: correctability gate + bounded actuator reduces mean delta_FNR and harmful-unit rate vs Always-On bounded, retaining utility

H4_K8_SUFFICIENT.claim: the main safety-utility tradeoff is preserved at K=8

H5_SAFE_DEPLOYABLE_OPERATING_POINT_EXIST.claim: at least one preregistered candidate satisfies delta_FNR <= +0.02 and delta_BA > 0 with CI supporting nonzero benefit under strict OOF / held-out evaluation

H6_DETECTOR_DEPENDENT.claim: DINOv2 is the main beneficiary; PatchCore/EfficientAD may abstain or have near-zero coverage without forced adaptation

forbidden: XGBoost / Random Forest / neural network / Transformer / AutoML
large feature search / outcome-driven actuator family search
using target anomaly to select lambda
using target anomaly to select cutoff
using target anomaly to decide correction direction
using target anomaly to decide abstention
continuing to use the old QM
claiming threshold-only gain as AUROC / representation improvement
deleting a detector because PatchCore/EfficientAD results are poor
adding candidates after seeing test results
